AesthetikWMS.description: Primary customization package — DAC extensions, graph extensions, WMS logic

AesthetikERP.description: Legacy ERP customization — imported but NOT published. Safe to delete from instance.

AesthetikSchemaFix.description: One-time schema fix — imported but NOT published. Safe to delete from instance.

AesthetikContainers.description: PO arrival dates, container tracking, trade compliance (StockItem tariff fields). <Sql> removed — columns created via [PXDB*] auto-create or manual SQL.

StudioBAuditTrail.description: GI: Studio B Audit Trail generic inquiry

FusionDeleteTableRecords.description: Fusion WMS — table record cleanup utility

AttributeUpdateScript.description: ONE TIME PUBLISH — attribute data migration

WayfairIntegration.description: Legacy Wayfair integration — replaced by Orderful EDI

UomRenamePieceToYds.description: PIECE->YDS UOM rename migration. REVERTED 2026-03-29 — production restored from Heritage Test after 20+ failed hotfix iterations. DO NOT re-deploy without: (1) Heritage Test clean, (2) validate-migration.py passing, (3) rollback pre-tested.

UomHotfixRestoreConversions.description: Hotfix v2: INSERT missing INUnit self-ref records for YDS (UnitType=1/2/3). Deployed as emergency hotfix 2026-03-29. Uses Microsoft.Data.SqlClient. Reverted with production restore from Heritage Test.

UomHotfixInventoryItemUom.description: Hotfix v20b: Fix null SalesUnit/PurchaseUnit on InventoryItem. Includes diagnostic SELECT queries. Deployed 2026-03-29. Reverted with production restore from Heritage Test.

UomRollbackYdsToPiece.description: Rollback: YDS->PIECE full UOM reversal. Had two packaging bugs — wrong internal zip filename + level="" attribute. Never successfully deployed. Production restored from Heritage Test instead. Both bugs now caught by validate-project.py --validate-zip.

categories.managed: Deployed and maintained via CI/CD pipeline. Changes tracked in git.
categories.isv: Third-party vendor packages. NOT managed by CI/CD. Updates come from vendor.
categories.one-time: One-time migration/setup scripts. Should NOT be republished (may re-run seed SQL).
categories.deprecated: No longer active. Safe to delete from instance. DO NOT publish.
categories.incident-response: Emergency packages deployed outside CI/CD during production incidents. Track for orphan detection. DO NOT republish without explicit review — these packages were deployed under pressure and may have been superseded by production restore.

validation_rules.managed_must_have_repo_dir: Every 'managed' project must have a repo_dir pointing to Customization/{name}/
validation_rules.deprecated_must_not_publish: Projects with category 'deprecated' must never be included in publishBegin
validation_rules.one_time_must_not_republish: Projects with category 'one-time' must not be republished (ISV republish re-runs seed SQL)
validation_rules.unknown_projects_block_deploy: Any project found on instance that's not in this manifest blocks the deploy
validation_rules.incident_response_must_not_republish: Projects with category 'incident-response' must not be republished without explicit review. They were deployed as emergency fixes during an incident and may have been superseded by a production restore.
